title.narrative: GSD/UPB/Partnership Platform on Localizing the SDGs/

description.narrative:
The Partnership Platform on Localizing the SDGs is a collaborative initiative designed to support countries and territories in advancing the localization of the 2030 Agenda. By fostering multilevel governance and multistakeholder partnerships, the Platform promotes national enabling environments for implementing the SDGs, while facilitating exchanges at local, national, and global levels. By working to establish coherence across levels and multilevel enabling environments for the SDGs, while building national and local delivery capacities, the Partnership Platform will focus on:
At the country level: • SDG Localization Frameworks: Accompany national governments to develop national policies and frameworks for SDG Localization. • City Support: Accompany cities through the SDG Cities process (data, decision-making, capacity building, finance) • Project implementation: build the capacities of national and local governments to identify, develop, fund, and implement high-impact projects with significant social and environmental benefits.
At the global level: • Mutual Learning: promote dialogue, knowledge development, and peer learning at the local, national, and global levels. • Coordination: with global initiatives such as the G7, G20, and OECD platforms. • Advocacy: hold annual high-level events to share lessons learned. • Knowledge: establish an online knowledge repository to provide resources, case studies, tools, and funding opportunities, accessible to all stakeholders.
The Platform is open to partners that can participate in different ways: • Strategic Partners: Provide strategic advice and help scale up activities. • Implementing/Knowledge Partners: Share technical expertise, resources, and active contributions to learning processes. • Financing Partners: Support operations and regional expansion through funding contributions.
Pilot Phase (2024–2026): During its initial two-year phase, the Platform will test approaches in select cities and countries, focusing on impactful projects and evaluating its structure and methods. It will scale up activities to other countries and regions based on outcomes.
